en: A black‑and‑white photographic postcard showing a carefully arranged set of fine porcelain tableware on a plain, neutral backdrop. The set includes two lidded tureens (one with a ladle), a tall lidded jug or coffee pot with a handle and spout, a small scalloped plate or saucer, and tiny accessories such as an egg cup and two napkin rings. All pieces are light-colored with dark, likely floral, decorative patterns. There is no visible text or caption on the front.
